title: Staff of Interruption

sources.title: Counterspell
markers: | description = Try to stop a spell being cast.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, Versatile, 5 ft melee, Dippable. 1d6 + 2 one-handed or 1d8 + 2 two-handed Bludgeoning plus Strength. +2 to attack rolls.
fields.Counterspell: Reaction once per Long Rest. Automatically interrupts spells of level 5 or lower. Higher-level spells require a check against DC 10 + spell level. The tooltip describes the caster’s spellcasting ability, but pinned game-script notes report it uses Intelligence. The spell source specifies a Reaction despite the item template’s Action label. Can counter cantrips but cannot itself be countered.
fields.Acquisition: Mayrina rewards Help the Hag Survivors. Adrielle can provide it when Mayrina is captive.
fields.Topple: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn. Prone breaks Concentration and expires at the start of the target’s turn. Topple skips main-hand weapon effects.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
